[Procurement Department Special Acquisitions List]

Rosin, violin cleaner and maintenance set, Leithanien. Purchase Price: ■■■■. Sales Price: -
Good to see that Amiya's been playing the violin more since we got back from Zelgrad. She used to say she didn't need any expensive maintenance equipment for it, and I didn't know any better. Only after talking to some Leithanian operators did I learn that good maintenance is always better, no matter the quality of the violin. She deserves it after all this Ursus stuff.

Compilation of various newspapers from across Terra. Purchase Price: ■■■■. Sales Price: -
Auto-scanner and reader, Kazimierz. Purchase Price: ■■■■. Sales Price: -
Kal'tsit didn't say anything, but of course she'd want to know what happened while she was gone.
The scanner and reader are gifts from me. So the Kazimierzians CAN make something useful once in a while, a scanner that can automatically turn pages, scan documents, and organize them is hard to find... maybe it was invented by a desperate secretary.

Smart Kettle Modification Kit, Columbia. Purchase Price: ■■■■. Sales Price: -
Basically a Tkaronto smart water purifier refit as a kettle. Because I couldn't find a 'smart kettle' anywhere? What do the Columbians have against kettles, anyway?
...Wait, what's so great about kettles, anyway?
Long story short, it's now operable by voice commands, and can control the water temperature and dispense cold, filtered water directly. Basically a compact water purifier. Like it or not, it's all yours, Doctor.

Handheld Electronic Game Dev Master V10.0, Higashi (Southern Court). Purchase Price: ■■■■. Sales Price: -
......

The recipients of these gifts were concerned that Closure was so busy that she forgot to treat herself, so they prepared their own gifts and went to thank her together. Their worries turned out to be unfounded, however, as they found her snoozing on her desk with a little trophy—in true Closure style—right next to her.
